{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# PBS -> Flux mapping (portable via flux batch CLI options):
#   nodes=1            -> -N 1
#   ppn=2              -> -n 1 (single task) with -c 2 (2 cores)
#   gpus=1             -> -g 1
#   walltime=24:00:00  -> -t 24h
#
# Submit with:
#   flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -c 2 -g 1 -t 24h ./piano.flux.sh
#
# NOTE: PBS -l mem=16GB not translated.
# Performance implication: without a memory limit/reservation, the job may be co-located more densely and can be OOM-killed by the node/OS or contend for memory, potentially reducing performance or reliability.
#
# NOTE: PBS resource tag ':k80' not translated.
# Performance implication: without a GPU model constraint, the job may run on a different GPU type, which can significantly change performance.
#
# NOTE: PBS -N piano-ARAUG not translated.
# Performance/ops implication: job naming/identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.
#
# NOTE: PBS -M rahul@cs.nyu.edu not translated.
# Performance/ops implication: no email notifications.
#
# NOTE: PBS -j oe (join stdout/stderr) not translated.
# Performance implication: none; operational implication: stdout/stderr handling will follow Flux defaults unless set at submission.

module purge
module load node
module load cmake
module load python/intel/2.7.6
module load numpy/intel/1.9.2
module load hdf5/intel/1.8.12
module load cuda/7.5.18
module load cudnn/7.0

RUNDIR=$SCRATCH/structuredinference/expt-polyphonic
cd "$RUNDIR" || exit 1

# Run within the allocation granted by `flux batch`.
flux run -n 1 -c 2 -g 1 \
  env THEANO_FLAGS="lib.cnmem=1.,scan.allow_gc=False,compiledir_format=gpu1" \
  python2.7 train_dkf.py -vm R -infm structured -ar 5000 -etype conditional -previnp -dset piano-sorted -bs 10 -dh 100 -ds 50
"
}
